读着听，听着读，
进度接得上。 Read it, or listen to it.

眼睛累了就闭眼听，想看时睁眼正好停在同一行。语阅是一款为认真读书的人准备的本地阅读器——没有账号、没有广告、没有推荐流，你的书和笔记永远只属于你自己。 Close your eyes and listen; look back down and you are on the exact same line. A quiet reading and listening app with no accounts, no ads, and no feeds—just your books, on your own devices.

纸本 · 温暖纸书 纸本·夜 · 深夜暖黑

清晨是万物苏醒的时刻，也是我一天中最值得珍视的时光。湖面如同一面未被惊动的镜子，映出岸边松林的倒影；每当我静下心来翻开一页书，周遭的喧嚣便退到很远的地方。 It is a truth universally acknowledged, that a single man in possession of a good fortune, must be in want of a wife. However little known the feelings or views of such a man may be on his first entering a neighbourhood, this truth is so well fixed in the minds of the surrounding families.

有一位不剧透的「书伴」 A reading companion that never spoils

长篇人物记混了、句子没读懂，随手问一句就好。它默认只看你已经读过的页数，每句话都能点回原文核对——不用担心被剧透结局。 Forgot who a character is or want to unpack a passage? Ask naturally—your companion reads only up to your bookmark and cites the exact line so endings stay safe.

《了不起的盖茨比》 · 第一章 The Great Gatsby · Chapter 1

在我年纪还轻、阅历不深的时候，父亲教导过我一句话，我至今还念念不忘。 In my younger and more vulnerable years my father gave me some advice that I’ve been turning over in my mind ever since.

“每逢你想要批评任何人的时候，”他对我说，“你就记住，这个世界上所有的人，并不是个个都有过你拥有的那些优越条件。” “Whenever you feel like criticizing any one,” he told me, “just remember that all the people in this world haven’t had the advantages that you’ve had.”

不用学复杂设置，在每个你想看书或听书的空隙里，它都顺手接得上。 No complicated setup—just a calm companion across every quiet pocket of your day.

放进来就能读，随时都能带走 Bring your own books, take your notes anywhere

EPUB、PDF、TXT、无加密的 MOBI / AZW3 电子书，以及 M4B / MP3 有声书与 RSS / OPML 播客。 EPUB, PDF, TXT, DRM-free MOBI / AZW3, plus M4B / MP3 audiobooks and RSS / OPML podcasts.
传书方式Adding Books
本地直接打开、同一网络下 Wi‑Fi 无线传书，或连接自己的家庭书库（Calibre、NAS 等）。 Open local files, send over local Wi‑Fi, or connect your personal home library (Calibre, NAS, and more).
跨设备同步Device Sync
使用你自己的 iCloud 云盘或私人网盘（坚果云、群晖、Nextcloud 等，Google Drive 即将支持），支持整库一键备份。 Through your own iCloud Drive or WebDAV cloud (Google Drive coming soon), plus one-file full-library backups.
导出笔记Export Notes
一键导出 Markdown、带划线的 EPUB、表格 CSV，或直发 Obsidian、Notion、flomo、新枝与 Anki。 Export to Markdown, highlighted EPUB, CSV, or send straight to Obsidian, Notion, flomo, Xinzhi, and Anki.

你可能想问Good to know

语阅真的完全免费、没有广告吗？Is Yuyue really free with no ads?+

是的。没有会员墙、没有开屏广告，也不需要注册账号，打开就能安心看书、听书、做笔记。

Yes—no subscriptions, no splash ads, and no sign-in wall. Just open the app and start reading.

怎么把我自己存的电子书放进语阅？How do I add my own e-books?+

在电脑上可以直接拖进窗口，在手机上可以直接导入本地文件或用同一 Wi‑Fi 无线传书；如果你平时用 Calibre 或家庭 NAS 管书，也能直接连上来挑书。

Drop files straight into the Mac window, import from your phone, send books over local Wi‑Fi, or browse your own Calibre or home library directly.

不用注册账号，手机和电脑怎么同步进度？How do my phone and computer stay in sync without an account?+

在设置里连上你自己的 iCloud 云盘或私人网盘（如坚果云、群晖、Nextcloud）就行。你的书和笔记只在你的设备和自己的网盘之间传，别人看不到。

Connect your own iCloud Drive or personal cloud drive in Settings. Your library travels strictly between your own devices and your own storage.

以后想换软件，划过的笔记能带走吗？Can I take my highlights and notes out anytime?+

随时可以。所有划线和想法都能导出为通用的 Markdown、带划线的电子书、表格，或者直接发到 Obsidian、Notion、flomo 和 Anki。

Anytime. Export every highlight and note to plain Markdown, highlighted EPUB, CSV, or send directly to Obsidian, Notion, flomo, and Anki.
